value.quote: voters and candidates all prefer policies as close as possible to z
value.note: The claims need several assumptions, and the model states each one: common interest, quadratic utility on which welfare is defined, strategic voters and candidates, the information structure, and that salaries raise office motivation (Section 1). That real voters are common-interest is a general fit-to-reality assumption, which the codebook excludes.

C9.2.reason: The welfare and salary claims follow from the formal results under assumptions the paper states explicitly in its model and introduction; B's extra requirement is only the general model-approximates-reality assumption, which the codebook says not to count.
